observe.scope-sha: {state} State House of Assembly (constituency covering {lga} LGA)
observe.reporting-opens-when-polls-open: Result reporting opens when polls open — {when}.
observe.choose-election-before-continuin: Choose which election you are reporting before continuing.
observe.no-race-open-here: No election is open for reporting at this unit yet. Each race shows the day it opens.
observe.near-me-offline: No connection for near me. Search or browse the register below.
observe.unit-list-not-on-phone: Unit list not on this phone yet. Connect once to download it, then this works offline.
observe.could-not-load-units: Could not load this ward’s units.
observe.no-units-in-this-ward: No units are listed for this ward.
observe.tier-notice-crowd: ◌ This unit's location is crowd-confirmed, not yet officially verified.
observe.tier-notice-unverified: ⚠ This unit has no verified location. Your GPS position will be recorded with your report, and the result stays marked "location unverified" until independent reports from the same spot corroborate it.
observe.draft-line-unit: {unit}, started at {time}. Your photos are still on this phone.
observe.draft-line: Started at {time}. Your photos are still on this phone.
observe.check-in-offline: Could not reach Hawkeye. Check your connection and try again.
observe.check-in-server-busy: Hawkeye could not record it just now. Try again in a minute.
observe.ocr-reading: 📖 Reading the numbers off your sheet photo… you can keep going — this fills in below when done.
observe.ocr-no-numbers: 📖 Could not read numbers off the photo — enter the counts from your sheet.
observe.ocr-failed: 📖 Could not read the photo here — enter the counts from your sheet.
observe.ocr-filled-one: ✨ 1 count auto-filled from your sheet photo (highlighted) — check it against the sheet and edit it if it is off.
observe.ocr-filled-n: ✨ {n} counts auto-filled from your sheet photo (highlighted) — check each against the sheet and edit anything that's off.
observe.ocr-numbers-read: 📖 Numbers read off your sheet photo (verify yourself): {list}
observe.ocr-cross-check: 🔎 OCR cross-check: {m}/{n} of your counts were read on the sheet photo.
pu.offline-browse-below: No connection. Browse the register below instead.
outbox.one-waiting: ⏳ 1 report is waiting to send. It sends by itself when you are back online.
outbox.one-waiting-signed-out: ⏳ 1 report is waiting to send. It sends when you sign in again.
outbox.n-waiting: ⏳ {n} reports are waiting to send. They send by themselves when you are back online.
outbox.n-waiting-signed-out: ⏳ {n} reports are waiting to send. They send when you sign in again.
incidents.saved-signed-out: You are signed out. Your report is saved on this phone and sends when you sign in again.
incidents.server-busy-saved: Hawkeye is busy right now — your report is saved on this phone and sends automatically.
map-unit.could-not-save-check-connection: Could not save — check your connection and try again.
practice.no-units-near: No units found near you. Search below, or use the practice unit.
practice.unit-step-hint: On election day you pick the unit you are standing at. Practise with your own, or use the practice unit.
practice.or-use-the-practice-unit: Or practise without a real unit:
practice.race-step-hint: In practice every race is open. On election day only the races held that day can be chosen.
